pepper.description: The HMAC key, used exactly as given (UTF-8). Generated peppers are 64 hex characters; an imported one may be any acceptable string of 32 to 256 characters.

version.description: Starts at 1; every change of value (rotate, or set to a different value) adds 1.

fingerprint.description: First 8 hex characters of SHA-256 over the pepper (UTF-8): compare it between apps without showing the pepper.

rotatedAt.description: When the value last changed (rotate or set).
